title: Flight Plan Filing Rework Rate
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flight:log route_type=* refiled=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(refiled="yes",1,0))) as matched by route_type
| eval a_refile_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_refile_pct
description: Measures the percentage of flight-plan filings that end with a refile by route type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which route type are helping or hurting flight-plan filings.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a refile` on `flight:log` events and summarize the hit rate by `route_type`.
visualization: Table of route type with percentage of flight-plan filings ending with a refile.
grandmaExplanation: It builds how often a refile happens for each route type so you can see where flight-plan filings go smoothly or get stuck.
